name: Surya Namaskar
note: Twelve poses. One set leads with the right leg, the next with the left; the two together are one round.
form: Twelve-pose form as taught by the Art of Living. Other schools order the sequence differently — this is the one the Codex follows.

poses.cue: Feet together at the front of the mat. Weight even. Palms together at the chest.
Arms up and back, biceps by the ears. Reach upward, do not fold backward.
Hinge from the waist with the spine long. Hands to the floor beside the feet. Bend the knees if you must.
Drive the lead leg back as far as it will go. Knee down. Eyes up.
Second leg back. One straight line from crown to heel. Arms vertical.
Knees down, hips back, slide forward. Chin and chest to the floor. Eight points touching.
Slide through and lift the chest. Elbows soft, shoulders away from the ears.
Hips and tailbone up into an inverted V. Reach the heels toward the floor.
Lead foot forward between the hands. Back knee down. Press the hips low.
Second foot forward. Palms stay planted. Straighten the knees as far as they will go.
Roll the spine up. Arms overhead, hips forward. Stretch up, not back.
Straighten. Arms down. Stand still and feel what the round did.
